text:
The positive Hektoen enteric agar culture identifies a Gram-negative enteric bacterium, and among the choices only Salmonella typhi grows on that medium. Clostridium difficile is an anaerobe recovered on other selective media, while Entamoeba histolytica and Giardia lamblia are protozoa and are not diagnosed by bacterial culture. The recent antibiotics are a distractor; the culture result makes Salmonella typhi the cause.

CONFIDENCE: 90
